title: Implement Robust Error Handling Mechanism
description: This feature matters because it will improve the overall stability and reliability of the yantraverse framework by providing informative error messages and handling edge cases. It will introduce a centralized error handling mechanism that will catch and log errors, allowing for better debugging and issue resolution. This will enhance the developer experience and reduce downtime
testCases: Test error handling for route not found
Test error handling for middleware errors
Test error handling for server crashes
acceptance: Error handling mechanism should log errors with relevant details, provide informative error messages to users, and prevent server crashes
reason: Implementing robust error handling is a high-impact feature that will significantly improve the production readiness and reliability of the yantraverse framework
